task.title: Register analytics-retention candidates and the authorization gate
task.input: job-foundation, the receivedAt retention deadline and aggregate expiresAt
task.output: The controlled analytics-retention job, default dry-run and candidate/actual counts
task.accept: 1) Caller the fixed operations analytics-retention leads to the service; isolated data must verify the expired set for 30-day raw data/13-calendar-month aggregates and removal of identifiers; do not reconstruct expired detail, and include coverage in the statistics (E-48, E-82). 2) Actual cleanup must be disabled by default with dryRun=true; without separate explicit retention authorization, reject requests for actual deletion and delete zero records; this task must not touch production/recovery/backup data, and must provide transaction/lease concurrency evidence (E-48, E-81).
